author: diodornellesc
quote: A generic entry compared to others in the series. The characters fail to engage. Numerous bugs and glitches. Various restrictions on what you can actually do. Impressive graphics and a massive map, and that’s where it ends.

author: diodornellesc
quote: A timeless game. I remember playing the original as if it were yesterday, and this remake evokes that same sense of grandeur. Excellent graphics, refined gameplay, and 60fps. It features a charming story about courage and overcoming evil. It is a wonderful game-one I recommend to my children, and will one day recommend to my grandchildren as a perfect embodiment of the idea that "what is truly good never dies or grows old." It is the *The Little Prince* of video games.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
